# Abu Dhabi Properties

> An independent guide to established real estate developers active in Abu Dhabi, covering their backgrounds, areas of activity and official websites.

Abu Dhabi Properties is an independent editorial directory about real estate developers in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It is not a real estate agency or broker, does not sell property and is not affiliated with the companies it profiles. Each profile links to the developer's official website.

## Key facts
- Website: https://www.abudhabi-properties.com/
- Topic: Residential real estate developers active in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
- Developers profiled: Aldar Properties, Modon, Bloom Holding, Reportage Group
- Contact: editor@abudhabi-properties.com

## Developer profiles
- [Aldar Properties](https://www.abudhabi-properties.com/developers/aldar/): An ADX-listed Abu Dhabi property group developing and managing master-planned communities across Yas Island, Saadiyat Island, Al Raha and Reem Island. Official website: https://www.aldar.com/en
- [Modon](https://www.abudhabi-properties.com/developers/modon/): An Abu Dhabi-based, ADX-listed holding company whose real estate arm is master-developing Hudayriyat Island alongside projects on Reem Island. Official website: https://www.modon.com/
- [Bloom Holding](https://www.abudhabi-properties.com/developers/bloom/): An Abu Dhabi developer and services group, part of National Holding, best known for the Bloom Living community in Zayed City and the Bloom Gardens neighbourhood. Official website: https://bloomholding.com/
- [Reportage Group](https://www.abudhabi-properties.com/developers/reportage/): An Abu Dhabi-headquartered developer founded in 2014, building apartment and community projects on Reem, Yas and Saadiyat islands and in Masdar City, with a growing international footprint. Official website: https://reportagegroup.com/

## Projects mentioned
- Saadiyat Lagoons by Aldar Properties (Saadiyat Island): Villa community
- Louvre Abu Dhabi Residences by Aldar Properties (Saadiyat Cultural District, Saadiyat Island): Apartments
- Gardenia Bay by Aldar Properties (Yas Island): Waterfront apartments
- The Sustainable City Yas Island by Aldar Properties (Yas Island): Villas and townhouses
- Noya by Aldar Properties (Yas Island): Villas and townhouses
- Gate Towers and Arc Towers by Aldar Properties (Reem Island): High-rise apartments
- Bashayer by Modon (Hudayriyat Island): Villas, apartments and townhomes
- Nawayef Village by Modon (Hudayriyat Island): Townhouses and twin villas
- Nawayef Park Views by Modon (Hudayriyat Island): Apartments
- Al Naseem Community by Modon (Hudayriyat Island): Villas
- Wadeem Gardens by Modon (Hudayriyat Island): Villas
- Tara Park by Modon (Reem Island): Apartments
- Bloom Living by Bloom Holding (Zayed City): Villas, townhouses and apartments
- Bloom Gardens by Bloom Holding (Eastern Mangrove Corniche): Villas and townhouses
- Aldhay by Bloom Holding (Bloom Gardens, Eastern Mangrove Corniche): Townhouses
- Soho Square by Bloom Holding (Saadiyat Island): Apartments, townhouses and penthouses
- Park View by Bloom Holding (Saadiyat Island): Apartments and hotel apartments
- Bloom Marina by Bloom Holding (Al Bateen): Waterfront apartments and serviced residences
- Marlin Icon by Reportage Group (Al Reem Island): Apartments and duplexes
- The District by Reportage Group (Al Reem Island): High-rise apartments
- Selina Bay by Reportage Group (Yas Island (Yas Bay area)): Apartments and townhouses
- Sensi by Reportage Group (Saadiyat Island): Residential community
- Oasis Residences 2 by Reportage Group (Masdar City): Apartments
- Sila by Reportage Group (Masdar City): Residential community
